title: CurseCore Field: Important Systems
summary: Read curse definitions, player data, symptoms, cleansing events, and consequence hooks.

blocks.title: Curse Records
blocks.body: Arcana Core definitions describe category, stage count, severity, visibility, discovery condition, symptoms, effects, cleansing methods, and contracts.

blocks.title: Live State
blocks.body: CurseCore persists player curse state and ticks server-side effects so rituals and scans can target something real.

blocks.title: Consequence Rules
blocks.body: Contracts, embraced curses, cursed mobs, area curses, and permanent decisions are future depth; the current slice focuses on safe live targets.

blocks.title: State Check
blocks.body: Use the system note to read the current state, then choose one action that answers it.
